name: Tag-Connect TC2030 (Cortex SWD)
mates: A Tag-Connect TC2030-CTX (or TC2030-CTX-NL, no legs) spring-pin cable, whose other end plugs into a probe's 10-pin Cortex debug connector, pressed onto a TC2030 pad footprint on the target (no header fitted).
connector: TC2030 footprint: 6 contact pads in 2 rows of 3 at 1.27 mm (0.05 in) pitch, with alignment holes (and leg latch holes for the legged cable)
numbering: From the TC2030-IDC footprint drawing (Rev B, 12/05/19): pads 1, 3, and 5 in one row and 2, 4, and 6 in the other, pad 2 beside pad 1, like a 2-row header. The drawing labels only pads 1, 2, 5, and 6, so pads 3 and 4 are read by position; check the drawing's view (one view is marked PCB bottom view). The cable maps these pads to the probe's Cortex 10-pin pins, so pad numbers are not the probe's pin numbers.

source.title: TC2030-CTX Plug-of-Nails Cable: ARM Cortex 10-pin Cable with 6-Pin TC2030 Plug-of-Nails Connector (1-page datasheet, no revision printed)

pins.note: Wired to the Cortex connector's pin 1 (VTref): the probe senses the target's I/O supply here.
The 6-pin cable carries no TDI, so it is SWD only, not full JTAG.
